collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A teenager's grandparent cannot walk to the festival this year, and the teenager is torn between going and staying.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A teenager's grandparent cannot walk to the festival this year, and (name1), the teenager, is torn between going and staying.

choices.label: Bring the Festival to the Grandparent.
Go and Report Back Every Hour.
Carry the Grandparent in a Litter with Friends.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They watch the lights from the doorway and talk late into the night.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The grandparent insists the teenager go, and they agree to return early with a story.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Friends come by with drums and food, and the hut becomes a small celebration.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)
a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Only a few come, but the grandparent is delighted anyway.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The grandparent enjoys the regular updates.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The teenager gets caught up in the festival and comes back late, apologizing.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The grandparent attends and has a wonderful time.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The grandparent declines, preferring to rest, and the teenager respects the choice.
